property_summary: For any fuzzed address x, a successful transferOwnership(x) must end with owner()==x and x != address(0) — i.e., ownership can never be transferred to the zero address; the mutant lets transferOwnership(address(0)) succeed and sets owner() to address(0).
change_summary: Remove the zero-address check so the owner can be transferred to address(0), making owner() return address(0).
